description.value: Lightwater Cove is an oceanfront eco-luxury B&B and destination spa perched on the rugged coastline of Salt Spring Island, set within a working organic farm surrounded by forest trails and a marine park reserve. The property offers four ocean-view suites with private decks, spa treatments, botanical gardens, and lily ponds, positioning itself as a high-end wellness retreat. Touring cyclists would find it a serene and scenic basecamp for exploring Salt Spring Island's coastline and trails.

address.value: 301 King Road, Salt Spring Island, BC V8K 1W9
